Five-Star Ornate Escape in World Heritage Puebla City with Authentic Mexican Bar

Puebla, Mexico

Immerse yourself in the timeless elegance of traditional Mexican design at the Banyan Tree Puebla, nestled within the beautifully preserved UNESCO World-Heritage listed city of Puebla. This five-star sanctuary offers a captivating journey through Mexico's past - the onsite Los Lavaderos bar dates back to the 19th century and offers an extensive list of cocktails.
